blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Two property registrars testified on Thursday that two parcels of land in the Davao Region purchased by Vice President Sara Duterte’s spouse, Atty. Manases Carpio, were not reflected in the vice president’s statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALN). Davao City Register of Deeds IV Kathy Florence Baldonado and Samal Deputy Register of Deeds III Marco Pineda took the witness stand to present documents in relation to Carpio’s properties in the region.
